newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo corn futures close higher across the board.

text.p: Tokyo corn futures closed higher across the board on Wednesday on light buying from local investors, traders said.
Prices ranged from 40 yen to 180 yen per tonne higher, with the benchmark May 1998 contract closing 180 yen up at 14,090 yen. The day's estimated trade volume was 47,090 lots.
Technical buying from individual investors emerged early in the afternoon, encouraged by the stronger trend in CBOT overnight corn trading, traders said.
The spot July corn contract on the CBOT Project A trading system was being traded at $2.65-1/2 per bushel at 0815 GMT, against $2.64-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
Spot July of the CBOT soybean futures on the overnight trading system stood at $8.32-3/4 at 0815 GMT, against $8.31-1/4 at Tuesday's close.
